brief: Recover install-root validation, level-dependent CD discovery and path table preparation.
decl: std::uint32_t installation_check(InstallationState &state, std::span<const InstallationRow> rows, const InstallationPlatform &platform);

bookkeeping.scope: Complete coordinator body with synthetic returning registry, profile, drive and file services; exact shipped path table included.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: At most31 valid terminated rows and nonempty terminated root. Exact shipped table has19 rows and no type3 row; two type2 rows are Music and Movies. Synthetic type3 rows are admitted only when installation level is not2. The original level2/type3 path consumes uninitialized stack bytes and is excluded. The empty-root precheck reads one byte before its buffer and is excluded. SEH, real registry/profile data, drives and files remain external.
bookkeeping.acceptance: 520 complete original-instruction calls compare return value, four globals, all8320 path-table bytes and ordered helper arguments on MSVC and Zig.
unresolved: Actual Windows registry/profile, drive and filesystem behavior; SEH exception behavior; empty-root inputs; arbitrary level2/type3 tables.
